project.name: UcFish Web Scraper & Markdown Converter
project.description: A comprehensive web scraping and content conversion tool designed to extract content from the UcFish website and convert it to well-structured Markdown files.

components.name: URL Discovery
components.purpose: Discovers and filters URLs from web pages

components.name: Content Extractor
components.purpose: Extracts meaningful content from HTML pages

components.name: Markdown Converter
components.purpose: Converts HTML content to Markdown format

components.name: Request Manager
components.purpose: Manages HTTP requests with concurrency control and rate limiting

components.name: Content Processor
components.purpose: Processes content through a pipeline of transformations

components.name: Content Verifier
components.purpose: Verifies the quality and completeness of extracted content

components.name: Metadata Store
components.purpose: Stores and manages metadata for scraped content

components.name: Content Merger
components.purpose: Merges related content to reduce fragmentation

components.name: Progress Monitor
components.purpose: Monitors and reports on scraping progress

components.name: CLI
components.purpose: Provides a command-line interface for the scraper

implementation_phases.name: Environment Setup
implementation_phases.description: Set up the project structure and dependencies

implementation_phases.name: Output Management
implementation_phases.description: Implement metadata storage and content merging

implementation_phases.name: Orchestration
implementation_phases.description: Implement the main scraper and progress monitoring

implementation_phases.name: User Interface
implementation_phases.description: Implement the CLI and programmatic API

programmatic.basic_usage:
const ucfishScraper = require('ucfish-scraper');
const result = await ucfishScraper.run({ baseUrl: 'https://example.com', maxDepth: 3 });

base.baseUrl: Base URL for the website to scrape

request.maxRetries: Maximum number of retries for failed requests (default: 3)

content.minContentLength: Minimum content length to consider valid (default: 100)
